body:
## Summary

Fixes #93

Brings every ecosystem up to date and turns `main` CI green again after the Dependabot merges in #84, #85 and #90. The full analysis, the before/latest/after tables from the registries, and the CI logs are in [`dev/log/issues/93/pulls/94/`](https://github.com/link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/tree/issue-93-75ce99e6d6e2/dev/log/issues/93/pulls/94).

### Why `main` was red (root cause)
`security-workflow-policy`, `release-workflow-policy` and `workflow-injection-policy` tests hard-coded the **previous** commit SHAs of `actions/checkout`, `actions/setup-dotnet` and `zizmorcore/zizmor-action`. Every Dependabot bump broke **Helper Checks** and **Lint and Format Check**. The merges stay as they are. The new `scripts/action-pins.mjs` (with tests) checks two rules instead:
- every `uses:` points to a 40-hex SHA with a version comment
- each action uses a single SHA across all workflows and the composite action

The tests no longer contain SHAs that Dependabot would have to keep in sync.

The two other `main` failures, `Check Codecov token` and `Release Preflight` (publishing identity is still a template placeholder), are human-action gates by design. They pass on PRs and fail on `main` with an explicit message. To clear them, the owner needs to set `CODECOV_TOKEN` and choose a real `PackageId`/`Authors`.

### Changes
- **JavaScript (bun):** `@types/node` 22→26, `eslint` 10.14.0, `typescript` 6→**7** (its stricter JSDoc checking needed real `@param` types), `minimatch` override 11.0.3. `bun.lock` regenerated.
- **.NET:** `net8.0` → **`net10.0`** (current LTS; .NET 8 support ends 2026-11-10).
  - The SDK is now pinned once in `global.json` and read by `setup-dotnet` (`global-json-file`), replacing 8 `dotnet-version: '8.0.x'` pins.
  - Removed MSBuild properties that 3 csproj files duplicated from `Directory.Build.props`.
  - All 3 lockfiles regenerated.
- **xUnit:** `xunit` 2.9.2 → **`xunit.v3.mtp-off` 4.0.2**. This supersedes #88; Dependabot closes #88 once `xunit` is gone.
  - `mtp-off` keeps VSTest, so `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk`, `xunit.runner.visualstudio`, `coverlet.collector` (from #86/#87/#89) and the Codecov collection keep working.
  - Adopted analyzer rule xUnit1051 (`TestContext.Current.CancellationToken`).
- **Example:** `examples/BasicUsage` already failed to build on `main` (14 analyzer errors) and CI never built it. It now builds and is in the solution, so CI covers it.
- **GitHub Actions:** every action is on its newest release (resolved via `gh api`, see `latest-actions.txt`).
- **pre-commit:** `pre-commit-hooks` v5.0.0 → v6.0.0. The hooks v6 removed are not used here.
- **Dependabot:** now covers `bun` (was `npm`), `nuget` in all 4 directories, `dotnet-sdk`, the composite action, and `pre-commit`.

### Left behind (with reason)
- `Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces` stays at 6.0.0 (transitive). xunit.v3 sets that floor, and on net10.0 the type is built in, so the polyfill is never used at runtime.

### Verification
- `bun run check` (eslint, prettier, tsc 7), 303 helper tests, `bun audit`: clean.
- `dotnet format --verify-no-changes`, Release build with warnings as errors, 21 tests with coverage, `dotnet pack`, example run: all pass.
- `dotnet list package --vulnerable --include-transitive`: no vulnerable packages.
- All PR checks pass on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows.

### Upstream reports
None. No workaround for an upstream bug was added.
title: Update all dependencies; target .NET 10 and xUnit v3; fix CI broken by Dependabot SHA bumps
